official.fact: DMA1RST and DMA2RST each reset the shared DMAMUX1 along with its named DMA engine; set/reset by software.

findings.classification: Concrete source omission; runtime manifestation not executed by reviewer
findings.fact: live and irq_domain observe DMA1EN, other gates/cache/System facts, but neither reads AHB1RSTR. submit/service and both owned IRQ paths therefore have no DMA reset-domain rejection before DMA/mux probes. Existing tainted logic already quarantines and isolates on observed gate/cache invalidity.
findings.consequence: After reset is asserted during a borrow, reset-cleared EN/count/flags/mux cannot be treated as observations of the original transfer's successful withdrawal. Cold preflight alone cannot detect a later asserted reset.
findings.narrow_fix: Subject to Root authorization, add the reset-domain level read to live and irq_domain before any DMA/mux probes. Reuse existing s->tainted, first-cause terminal and owned-vector isolation; retain request, endpoint, CS/clock ownership and active state. Do not clear shared reset bits or infer recovery after deassertion.

findings.classification: Concrete source omission; broader than reset-only because no common runtime DMA gate guard exists
anchors: soc/stm32h743/drivers/uart_dma.c:331 DMA IRQ /342 USART IRQ /351 stop
soc/stm32h743/drivers/uart_receive.c:331 rx_start /363 rx_stop /442 stop /512 DMA IRQ /523 USART IRQ
findings.fact: AHB1ENR DMA1EN is checked only in the two initialize functions at uart_dma.c431 and uart_receive.c488. Runtime TX submit checks cached/initialized/retained state; runtime TX observe/service/IRQ have no DMA gate/reset validity test. RX start/arm/finish check cache at some boundaries but service/IRQs and detach read DMA/NDTR without DMA gate/reset qualification. Delegation to ordinary uart_ops does not supply that guard.
findings.consequence: RX finish derives length=capacity-NDTR after detach and may publish/abort a producer loan. A reset-cleared NDTR is not an established prefix of the pre-reset transfer. A candidate test is: real active RX, externally assert held reset, request stop; old logic can evaluate reset values as drain facts. This is a source-derived candidate, not an actual RED or proven hardware trace.
findings.state_constraint: TX has no independent sticky domain-taint field; terminal must preserve first-latched cancel/timeout/error. RX quarantined is currently a retryable withdrawal flag and is cleared by finish/arm. Do not repurpose these into a permanent taint without a reviewed semantic change, or set PREPARING/PROCESSING to fictitious work. A mode-private taint bit may be the smallest honest solution; Root must authorize any private-state change. Shared ordinary UART state/public faces need not grow.

findings.classification: Official reset-domain fact affecting both cold and runtime plans
findings.fact: DMA1RST resets DMA1 and DMAMUX1; DMA2RST resets DMA2 and DMAMUX1. A DMA1 path depends on its engine and its DMAMUX1 selector. Holding DMA2RST can invalidate that selector while DMA1EN remains set.
findings.recommendation: Use an explicitly reviewed effective reset mask covering DMA1RST|DMA2RST for DMA1+DMAMUX1 operation, unless a narrower official silicon-specific fact is supplied. This is one RCC read and one mask; do not add a fictional independent DMAMUX1 enable/reset owner. Root must decide any extension of the current D2 cold-check task; no D2 source is changed here.

findings.classification: Adjacent source fact; not an instruction to expand this batch
findings.fact: clock_ready checks identity/trim/System, APB2ENR and selector, but does not read APB2RSTR. reset() checks the two reset writes it owns during cleanup. That checked cleanup operation is distinct from a live reset-domain guard. Do not claim SPI peripheral runtime reset is already independently observed; broader SPI/USART reset review stays separate.

contract_assessment.valid_use: Trusted constructors and exclusive owners require stable clocks/reset/cache. A foreign runtime MMIO reset violates that external ownership precondition; this audit does not invent a legal second reset owner or say valid application calls may reset a borrowed controller.
contract_assessment.why_gap_still_matters: The provider already promises defensive containment of observed invalid gates/cache, and drain/release relies on live hardware facts. A held, observable reset invalidates those facts just as an observed gate loss does. Continuing to interpret its reset values as transfer proof is a real missing containment branch under that failure model, rather than a request for arbitrary fault-history detection.
contract_assessment.observation_limit: Only held or actually observed reset levels can be detected. An assert/deassert pulse entirely between observations is not claimed detectable. Once invalidity is observed, software must latch it; deassertion alone does not restore the interrupted transfer's provenance.
contract_assessment.recovery: No automatic DMA/DMAMUX reset/deassertion, request settlement, RX publication/abort, buffer zeroing or clock-lease release. Stop/cancel remain controls, not borrow revocation. Permanent taint may require an explicitly separate product/owner fail-stop or destructive recovery contract.
contract_assessment.physical_model: A software clear-EN request differs from observed EN0. Do not fabricate normal DMA EN0 plus all valid completion facts with uncommitted memory. The reset-domain regression can instead count/reject any DMA/mux access while reset is asserted and prove no settlement/publication; it need not invent bus behavior while the domain is reset.

next_batch_proposal.model_boundary: Prefer the existing per-DMA external port over edits to global h743_model. Observe actual RCC level and addressed stream/mux ranges, never SUT flags or internal stage. Do not grow a generic DMA framework, dispatch layer, pool or registry.
tests: Initialize a real legal instance, then assert held DMA1RST before submit/rx_start: STATE rejection, no borrowed request/block, no DMA/mux probes or writes.

Borrow normally, then assert each effective reset bit during a live SPI/TX/RX operation; service and owned IRQ must latch taint/Q before peripheral probes, retain loans/leases and perform only allowed owned-NVIC isolation.

After that observation, clear the external reset level: repeated service/cancel/stop must not settle/publish/abort/reserve again or release the retained owner merely because zero registers now look idle.

Inject reset through the existing unmasked cache hook; recheck after TX pre-clean and RX post-invalidation, before further DMA access or final publication. Preserve first cause if cancellation/timeout was already latched.
Preserve peer-lane/vector flags and shared reset bits. Guard failures must not write AHB1RSTR or adopt a foreign reset owner.

Execute complete affected existing programs first RED then minimal fix GREEN, keep all old assertions. Recompute MMIO bounds on the final tuple; cold-program actualRED results are not runtime-branch evidence.

cost_tradeoff.cold_only: One initialization check is cheapest but leaves post-admission resets unobserved; it is not a runtime proof.
cost_tradeoff.runtime: One AHB1RSTR read per live/IRQ entry can check both bits; existing DMA1EN read is retained. No per-byte indirection is needed. Cache maintenance temporarily unmasks execution, so post-maintenance re-observation is a distinct required boundary.
cost_tradeoff.accounting: SPI can reuse its existing private taint with no state growth. UART may need mode-only sticky state, and its gate guard is newly required. Exact flash/state/MMIO/cycle cost must be measured after implementation; this report makes no WCET or hardware guarantee.

validation_status: No runtime tests, builds, tool installation, network, Main/index mutation, D2 edits or new qualification were performed. Root-reported cold test failures are not reused as runtime proof.
